title.zh: 将三描礼士省立中学改设为三描礼士国立中学并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting Zambales Provincial High School Into Zambales National High School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting Zambales Provincial High School Into Zambales National High School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Zambales Provincial thành Trường Trung học Zambales Quốc gia, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Zambales Provincial เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Zambales แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Sekolah Menengah Zambales Provincial menjadi Sekolah Menengah Zambales Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5713_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Zambales Provincial High School is hereby converted into a national high school to be known as Zambales National High School, effective upon availability of funds.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the conversion, operation and maintenance of said high school during the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 21, 1969.
